PILOT DETAILS

RegForward Pulse comes first.
More tools when useful.

Start with a focused opportunity brief built from public sources. Regulatory synthesis and CMC drafting are separate pilot conversations. The consultant owns professional decisions and client communication.

PILOT INQUIRIES

RegForward Pulse

For independent consultants and practices seeking a focused way to identify prospective CMC clients.

Typical use

Find biotechnology companies with public signals of possible CMC support needs, then prepare for an introductory conversation.

What you receive

  • A comprehensive, source-linked company and program brief
  • Potential need assessment and unanswered questions
  • A complete, personalized outreach draft for your review

RegForward Pulse starts with public information, so an initial pilot does not require client documents. The consultant reviews the evidence, qualifies the opportunity, and leads outreach.

Discuss RegForward Pulse →
PILOT INQUIRIES

RegForward Navigate

For CMC consultants and practices exploring guidelines and documents they are authorized to access.

Typical use

Find relevant passages across sources, compare them, and synthesize the answer with links to the original material.

What you receive

  • Synthesized answers with links to original sources
  • Document comparisons
  • Organized evidence notes

Verify the cited sources and interpretation. Do not upload employer or client proprietary information without authorization. RegForward Navigate is a knowledge aid.

Discuss RegForward Navigate →
PILOT INQUIRIES

RegForward Author

For consultants preparing briefing packages, IND and IMPD applications, BLAs, and equivalent global dossiers.

Typical use

Use AI-assisted drafting and quality-control workflows against authorized source documents, templates, relevant guidelines, health authority expectations, and the consultant's own expertise.

What you receive

  • Working drafts of briefing packages, eCTD sections, and other regulatory documents
  • Source-to-draft checks and alignment questions for consultant review
  • Open issues and decisions requiring expert resolution

All generated content requires professional review. Outputs are not submission-ready; the consultant remains responsible for the final deliverable.

SPOTLIGHT / REGFORWARD PULSE

RegForward Pulse turns public signals into
better conversations.

A contained first step for consultants: define your focus, review a cited opportunity brief, and decide whether a conversation is worth pursuing.

01

Define your focus

Share your specialties, target companies, development stages, and preferred engagement types.

02

Review a researched brief

Review a comprehensive, source-linked brief and a planned opportunity score that brings together multiple public signals. The consultant checks the evidence before qualifying an opportunity.

03

Lead the outreach

Select promising leads and shape a personalized outreach strategy that connects verified signals with your own relevant experience.

Start with public evidence and one practical output: a brief you can assess before choosing whether to pursue the lead. Pilot details are agreed individually.

REGFORWARD PULSE / ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLE

See how a lead
could be qualified.

This condensed fictional example shows what a RegForward Pulse opportunity brief could contain, including the evidence behind a lead and a fully written outreach draft. A consultant would receive a comprehensive, source-linked brief with company context, evidence, fit analysis, open questions, and a complete draft to review.

FICTIONAL WORKED EXAMPLE · CONDENSED PREVIEW

BiotechABC

Hypothetical preclinical antibody program · planning for an IND-enabling milestone

NOT A REAL LEAD
ILLUSTRATIVE PRIORITYWorth a closer look

What the example shows: An upcoming IND-enabling milestone, a planned manufacturing transfer, and financing directed toward development. Potential CMC support to discuss: control strategy, stability planning, and IND CMC preparation. Outreach would confirm the company's priorities.

What the evidence review would examine

01 / PROGRAM
Development milestone

The fictional October program update places ABC-101 in IND-enabling studies and describes a planned filing milestone, creating a timely CMC planning window.

Illustrative source: company program page or announcement
02 / OPERATIONS
CMC work ahead

A planned manufacturing transfer brings process characterization, control strategy, stability planning, and documentation into focus ahead of the filing.

Illustrative source: public manufacturing or partner update
03 / INVESTMENT
Program funding

In this fictional scenario, a financing announcement earmarks resources for ABC-101's IND-enabling work and manufacturing readiness. It signals continued investment in the program.

Illustrative source: company financing announcement

Planned opportunity score

The planned opportunity score would use an internally developed, weighted signal model to prioritize opportunities for consultant review. This fictional example illustrates the type of lead it could surface; the specific signals and weights remain internal.

Potential CMC support

A targeted engagement could support CMC regulatory strategy, control strategy, stability planning, or preparation of IND CMC content, aligned with BiotechABC's priorities and timeline.

Conversation starters

  • Which IND-enabling milestones matter most this year?
  • How is the manufacturing transfer shaping CMC planning?
  • Which CMC workstreams are highest priority ahead of the IND?
  • Where could a specialist perspective add value?

Supporting context

  • Company program update and expected development timing.
  • Manufacturing transfer or partner announcement.
  • Financing announcement and stated use of funds.
  • Original source links and excerpts for consultant review.

Complete outreach example for consultant review

Fictional scenario: BiotechABC's October 2026 update describes ABC-101, a preclinical antibody entering IND-enabling studies, with a manufacturing transfer planned for early 2027. A separate fictional financing announcement says the company plans to fund IND-enabling work and manufacturing readiness. Dr. Maya Chen is a fictional independent consultant with biologics CMC and IND preparation experience. Dr. Alex Reed is the fictional development lead.

Subject: CMC planning for ABC-101's IND-enabling phase

Dear Dr. Reed,

I read BiotechABC's October update on ABC-101. The planned IND-enabling studies and early-2027 manufacturing transfer suggest a useful point to align the process characterization, analytical methods, stability plan, and regulatory narrative.

I advise emerging biologics teams on CMC strategy and IND preparation. In a recent antibody program, I helped the team turn manufacturing-transfer data gaps into a focused IND CMC workplan. If BiotechABC is considering outside support, I would welcome a short discussion about the ABC-101 timeline and whether a targeted gap review would be useful.

I would start with the transfer plan, current control strategy, and evidence needed for the proposed IND. A concise assessment could help your team prioritize work ahead of the filing.

Would a 20-minute conversation next week be useful?

Best,
Dr. Maya Chen
Independent CMC Regulatory Consultant

The names, program update, timeline, and consultant experience in this example are fictional. A real brief and outreach draft would be based on documented sources and the consultant's verified profile; the consultant reviews the completed draft before use.

How RegForward AI supports the consultant

RegForward Pulse helps surface and assess potential leads. The consultant decides whom to contact, what to say, and what to deliver.

RegForward Navigate supports source-linked regulatory synthesis; RegForward Author helps prepare working submission content.

BiotechABC, ABC-101, the people, and every signal above are fictional. The planned opportunity score will be evaluated and refined during pilots using consultant feedback and observed qualification outcomes. Consultants review the original sources and decide which opportunities warrant outreach.
